#SHARK x #ODDS (@sharkallday x @nose_tranger) 

After Shooting That AGOD Billy, I Set Off On My Quest North To Head To Work. To My Surprise I Looked Over My Right Shoulder And Saw This Running Off The Freeway. So Of Course I Pulled Over, Parked Alongside The Freeway, & Walked Back To Capture This Moment☠️??‍☠️

I Believe This May Have Been My First Time Seeing ODDS Work Outside Of The Bay Area (where I primarily shoot his art) So I Definitely Had To Get This One Documented For My Broskis ???

Help Me Keep These Landmarks Safe By Not Publicly Disclosing Spot Locations On My Page Please & Thank You??

“Train Yard Lurks Chapter 56, The Walkthroughs”

Here Are 3 Clips I Mashed Up Together That I Felt Deserved Some Extra Love From This Train Yard Lurk Session?️

First Clip; Featuring The Works Of #BISER (@losangeles_bsr) 

He Caught Two Fresh Autoracks & Sent Them My Way. One He Collaborated With KASIO On The Second Was A Solo Burner. Sadly Based On Where This Autorack Landed In Line Ln The Yard, It Was Sandwiched Between Another Line. 

So I Had To Use That Wide Angle In Order To Check Out This Piece In All It’s Glory✨

Second Video Is A #WholeCar Or #EndToEnd By #SEIMR (@hey_look_up_there) 

This Car Had Bounced Around The Yard A Few Times. First Time I Saw It, It Was Trapped Between Two Lines. Second Time It Was In A Spot Where I Could Capture A Great Photo Of The Whole Car. When I Saw It This Time, It Was On The Repair Line…So I Made Sure To Capture A Video Of It As Well For The Archives☠️??‍☠️

Last But Not Least, A Quick Clip Of A Tag By #CANAS (@thereal_lefthandedbandi
